hooks.command: FILE="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; PROJ=$(git -C "$(dirname "$FILE")" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.py$' && [ -n "$PROJ" ]; then cd "$PROJ/backend" && .venv/bin/ruff check --fix "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true; fi

FILE="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; PROJ=$(git -C "$(dirname "$FILE")" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.(tsx?|ts)$' && [ -n "$PROJ" ]; then cd "$PROJ/frontend" && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -20 || true; fi

FILE="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; PROJ=$(git -C "$(dirname "$FILE")" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE 'alembic/versions/.*\.py$' && [ -n "$PROJ" ]; then cd "$PROJ/backend" && TMPDB=$(mktemp /tmp/quantfolio_hook_XXXXXX.db) && DATABASE_URL="sqlite:///$TMPDB" .venv/bin/alembic upgrade head 2>&1 | tail -15; rm -f "$TMPDB"; fi

FILE="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; PROJ=$(git -C "$(dirname "$FILE")" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); BASE=$(echo "$FILE" | sed -n 's#.*/backend/app/\(foundation\|lab\|decision\|interface\)/\(.*\)\.py#\2#p'); if [ -n "$BASE" ] && [ -n "$PROJ" ] && [ -f "$PROJ/backend/tests/test_${BASE}.py" ]; then cd "$PROJ/backend" && .venv/bin/pytest "tests/test_${BASE}.py" -x -q 2>&1 | tail -10; fi

FILE="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; PROJ=$(git -C "$(dirname "$FILE")" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); BASE=$(echo "$FILE" | sed -n 's|.*/backend/tests/test_\(.*\)\.py|\1|p'); if [ -n "$BASE" ] && [ -n "$PROJ" ]; then cd "$PROJ/backend" && .venv/bin/pytest "tests/test_${BASE}.py" -x -q 2>&1 | tail -10; fi

FILE="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; PROJ=$(git -C "$(dirname "$FILE")" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.(tsx?)$' && [ -n "$PROJ" ]; then cd "$PROJ/frontend" && npx vitest run --reporter=verbose --related "$FILE" 2>&1 | tail -15; fi
FILE="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.env$|\.env\..*|secrets|credentials'; then echo 'BLOCK: editing a secrets/env file — confirm this is intentional' && exit 2; fi
